purpose: Exploratory refinement of the training-side penalty grid under the unchanged effectiveness constraint
grid: xi=k/200 for k=0..100, plus 1,2,4,8; 105 total candidates
training_data: Reuse the saved five-page-group OOF gain/downside arrays and proposal/reference outcomes for the same 1000 adaptation queries
admissibility: OOF nDCG >= OOF Always nDCG - 0.005 and OOF CVaR <= OOF Always CVaR
empty_admissible_set: Retain xi=0 and record failure to meet constraints
numeric_comparisons: Unrounded float64; zero comparison tolerance; exact lexicographic tie-breaking
decision: linear empirical q0.05(G-xi*D)>0, otherwise complete frozen reference
test_policy: Freeze selected coefficient and predictions; evaluate only the selected rule, not a test grid
evaluation: Full 2000-query and conditional 1407 reachable cohorts, paired 20-source-page-cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed20261015; nominal percentile CI
reporting: nDCG, MRR, Recall, QDR, ED, CVaR
both beneficial and adverse paired effects
interpretation: Previously evaluated test cohort; this refinement is exploratory and cannot be described as an independent confirmation
paper_adoption: Assess the full effectiveness-downside trade-off; do not select or claim improvement from interception count alone
